episode_summary: In this episode, Alex Maldonado shares strategies for helping first-time home buyers overcome financial hurdles by using seller and lender credits. He also discusses effective lead generation techniques, including SEO and targeted ads, and emphasizes the importance of optimizing Google business profiles. Additionally, Alex highlights the value of bilingual marketing and community engagement in real estate.
